_comment: Weekly snapshots of the OPEN CommitFest, used to compute week-over-week deltas. Only the MOST RECENT week is kept in full (needed to track the fate of a patch flagged a week ago); every earlier week is collapsed to {week, cf, created_n, closed_n, net}. Full history lives in references/archive/commitfest-2026.json (not read at runtime).
